episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In order to gain money, the crew enters the Dead End Race, a dangerous anything goes sailing competition. On the starting island of the race the crew is introduced to that year's favorite, General Gasparde, a former navy general who deserted after killing his men. The race proceeds and after lots of fighting and Gasparde's treachery, it all comes down to him and Luffy, one on one.

info.title: Tasuketsu -Fate of the Majority-
info.synopsis: Una notte, tutti gli abitanti di un villaggio muoiono misteriosamente. Solo un piccolo gruppo di adolescenti sembra essere sopravvissuto, quando ecco accadere un altro fatto strano: tutti i ragazzi ricevono un messaggio sul loro computer. Nel crudele gioco di sopravvivenza che ne consegue, un ragazzo e una ragazza decidono di unire le proprie forze per combattere la misteriosa entità che tira le redini dei loro destini.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: Saneatsu Narita’s ordinary school life is disrupted by a mysterious yes-or-no message. The following morning, Tokyo is transformed by an unexplained catastrophe, leaving Saneatsu and a handful of classmates searching for answers. They soon discover that they have been drawn into Tasuketsu, a deadly game controlled by the enigmatic Emperor.

episodes.title: Good Intentions
episodes.synopsis: Reeling from the consequences of the latest Tasuketsu vote, the remaining survivors search for the Emperor’s designated postbox and a way to fight back. As they learn more about the mysterious Rights that grant extraordinary abilities, hidden motives begin to emerge and trusting the people around them becomes increasingly difficult.

episodes.title: Motion
episodes.synopsis: After learning that a traitor may be hiding among their allies, Saneatsu secretly works with Saaya to uncover the truth. As they put their plan into motion, the investigation reveals an even greater threat involving a powerful special Right, placing Saneatsu in grave danger.

episodes.title: Transition
episodes.synopsis: Separated from Saneatsu and the others while fleeing, Omi and Kazuhiko are rescued by an eccentric boy with a powerful special Right. As they search for a way to reunite with their companions, the Emperor announces a new stage of Tasuketsu, bringing another dangerous change to the survival game.

episodes.title: Nearby
episodes.synopsis: Iruga demands that Saneatsu and his friends hand over Midō and Omi to him so that he can overthrow the Emperor. In return, he reveals the goal that he and his partner are pursuing. In Nerima, Sudō encounters his teacher, Shinozaki, but also Midō.

episodes.title: Assemble
episodes.synopsis: As Eren suddenly disappears and Rika joins the group, Saneatsu begins questioning why he cannot obtain a Special Right. Omi’s explanation of the Rights and the mysterious detention facility brings them closer to understanding the Emperor’s power, while Eren’s search leads to an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: Pass Down
episodes.synopsis: Shaken by a series of troubling revelations, Saneatsu considers leaving the group, but his friends refuse to let him face the burden alone. To confirm Sudo’s theory about the Emperor’s whereabouts, they devise a plan to draw out someone who may possess the information they need.

episodes.title: Operation
episodes.synopsis: Saneatsu and the others finally obtain reliable information about the Emperor’s location and learn more about the powers surrounding Tasuketsu. With new allies joining their cause, the group prepares an ambitious operation to confront the Emperor and bring the deadly game to an end.

episodes.title: Emperor
episodes.synopsis: The operation to overthrow the Emperor finally begins. While their allies create a diversion against the vast army of puppets surrounding his tower and target key power stations, Saneatsu, Saaya, Omi and Ryuta use the opportunity to infiltrate the stronghold and move closer to confronting their mysterious enemy.

episodes.title: Closing
episodes.synopsis: Having reached the Emperor’s tower, Saneatsu finally comes face to face with the mastermind behind Tasuketsu. As the final vote begins, he and Saaya stake everything on defeating the Emperor and bringing the deadly survival game to an end.

episodes.title: Foreboding
episodes.synopsis: A month after the battle at the Emperor’s tower, Gobō and his allies struggle to maintain order by using a false Emperor as a deterrent. Their fragile stability is threatened when someone else suddenly claims the Emperor’s name on television, prompting them to investigate the mysterious broadcast.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.synopsis: Brought to the group’s hideout, Raion comes face to face with the false Emperor and attempts to uncover his allies’ intentions. Before long, he is forced to reveal his own objective, while a mysterious figure calling herself the Queen interrupts a television broadcast with a declaration that threatens the fragile new order.

episodes.title: Shock
episodes.synopsis: After proving his abilities, Raion officially joins Gobō and the others. As the group prepares to confront the Queen’s forces, Raion, Sōma and Nishime head to the broadcasting station, where an unexpected enemy with a dangerous Special Right stands in their way.

episodes.title: Bugia
episodes.synopsis: Mentre la Regina potenzia le sue difese, Raion e gli altri si interrogano su come sia possibile quanto hanno visto. Entrambi i gruppi si trovano in una fase di stallo, ma a Raion viene un'idea per sbloccare la situazione e raccogliere ulteriori informazioni.

episodes.title: Interrogation
episodes.synopsis: At the Emperor’s tower, Raion, Omi and Ryuta confront Meguru and Knight as they attempt to force their way inside. While Raion uses deception to gain the upper hand, Ryuta struggles against Knight’s formidable abilities, until unexpected reinforcements arrive and shift the balance of the fight.

episodes.title: Comrade
episodes.synopsis: Yagihashi and Sudo interrogate Mutsuki in hopes of uncovering more about the Queen and her forces. As Raion reflects on his place within the group, new information allows the others to reassess the situation and begin preparing their next major operation.

episodes.title: The Scenario
episodes.synopsis: As the Queen prepares for an all-out confrontation, unexpected allies join her cause. Meanwhile, Jin shares new information about a mysterious way of summoning Special Rights, and Sudo launches an ambitious operation to seal off Tokyo. The plan initially progresses, but a new power threatens to overturn their advantage.

episodes.title: Covertness
episodes.synopsis: With morale shaken after their failed operation, Gobō and the others receive unexpected information about the Queen’s forces. Their situation grows more dangerous when the Emperor resumes Tasuketsu, while a secret scheme within the Queen’s camp begins to create new tensions.

episodes.title: Innocence
episodes.synopsis: Raion questions Yagihashi and Sudo’s increasingly ruthless methods as tensions grow within the group. Meanwhile, the Emperor begins hunting down holders of powerful Rights across Tokyo, prompting Sudo to send Raion and Ryuta to confront the growing threat before his forces become even stronger.

episodes.title: Loyalty
episodes.synopsis: Working as a double agent, Raion infiltrates the Queen’s forces and uses Gobō’s ability to narrow down the location of their hideout. His mission becomes far more dangerous when the Queen tests his loyalty by ordering him to bring Sōma to her, forcing the group to consider a risky response.

episodes.title: Either Fate, or a Miracle
episodes.synopsis: Raion is devastated by the outcome of the operation to rescue Hikari and struggles with guilt over his role in the plan. Meanwhile, Hirayama and Fukami make their move within the Queen’s camp, but Kirishima’s intervention places their dangerous scheme in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Battlefront
episodes.synopsis: New revelations about the origins of the Special Rights bring the conflict closer to its decisive stage. As the Queen and Emperor make their next move, the opposing forces converge on the Emperor’s tower, where the long-awaited final battle begins.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.synopsis: As the final battle intensifies, the false Emperor’s team uses carefully coordinated tactics to push through the Queen’s forces. Meanwhile, Raion joins Iruga in confronting the formidable Kirishima, putting a dangerous plan into motion that could determine the outcome of the conflict.

episodes.title: Towards the Light
episodes.synopsis: As the final battle reaches its climax, both sides turn to their most powerful remaining abilities. While the Queen prepares a decisive move, Raion makes one last attempt to reach the Emperor, hoping his words can change the course of the conflict before it is too late.

info.title: Amatsuki
info.synopsis: Tokidoki è uno studente delle superiori, che in seguito alla bocciatura all'esame di storia inizia a lavorare in un moderno museo tecnologico nel quale è riprodotta una cittadina dell'epoca Edo attraverso fondali, set, comparse e con l'aiuto di appositi occhiali è possibile riprodurre una realtà virtuale nel quale ogni cosa è riprodotta come se fosse vera. Tuttavia il ragazzo si smarrisce e viene attaccato da due strani personaggi, gli occhiali si rompono e però il mondo non svanisce. Dopo essere stato salvato da una ragazza con la katana e aver incontrato Shinonome si rende conto di essere intrappolato nel passato.

episodes.title: This Rainy Night's Moon
episodes.synopsis: After failing another history test, Tokidoki Rikugou goes to a high-tech history museum for a makeup class. The museum creates a virtual Edo period using special goggles and a large room. There Tokidoki meets and befriends Kon Shinonome, a makeup student like himself. Tokidoki speaks with him until Kon suddenly disappears. When Tokidoki comes to a bridge in the exhibit he loses an eye from being attacked by a Nue, and is helpless to do anything until a female samurai named Kuchiha comes to his rescue. When Tokidoki comes to later, he finds out that he may actually be in the Edo time period.

episodes.title: The Voice That Calls To Dogs
episodes.synopsis: Tokidoki goes to the temple and is introduced to the monk, Shamon, who tells Tokidoki that like Shinonome, he is stuck in this world with no way of returning home. Tokidoki doesn't let this bother him though and decides he'll do his best to do what he can at the temple. When Kuchiha is threatened by some samurai, Tokidoki stands up to fight them, only to have Kuchiha save him in the end, by exposing her secret: she's an inugami-tsuki possessed by a dog spirit. The samurai flee for their lives and Kuchiha gets mad at Tokidoki for having interferred in the first place. Unable to let the samurai get away, Tokidoki convinces Shinonome and the watchman, Heihachi, to help him pull a prank on one of the samurai to teach them a lesson.

info.title: True Beauty (JAP)
info.synopsis: Im JuGyung, quattrocchi e brufolosa, è sempre stata ritenuta un racchia e presa in giro per il suo aspetto fisico e per i suoi gusti da otaku: ama i manga e film horror, i videogame e la musica hard rock. Dato che deve cambiare scuola, vuole cambiare anche la sua immagine. Così passa le intere vacanze sulla rete a divorare tutorial di moda e make up. I risultati sono strabilianti, ora tutti la trovano bellissima, il problema sarà mantenere l'aspetto da dea e non far scoprire la sua vera indole. Ovviamente una sera, nella fumetteria di quartiere, si imbattette tutta sfatta in uno dei ragazzi più popolari della scuola, Lee SuHo, e lui la riconosce. Ma sarà meglio il bel otaku, che l'apprezza per quella che è davvero o l'affascinate modello ex idol Han SeoJoon che si comincia ad interessare a lei, ma conoscendone solo il lato posato e truccato? In un mondo dominato dai social tutti postano solo il lato migliore di se stessi, tutti appaiono belli e felici, ma ognuno nasconde un doloroso segreto...

episodes.title: Discende una dea?!
episodes.synopsis: Jugyeong è sempre stata bullizzata per via del suo aspetto fisico, ma quando cambia scuola le cose iniziano ad andare per il verso giusto: grazie al trucco riesce a stringere nuove amicizie e tutti la rispettano! Tuttavia, qualcuno potrebbe rovinare questa nuova oasi di felicità...

episodes.title: Sono completamente fregata!
episodes.synopsis: Suho Lee ha scoperto il segreto di Jugyeong e la obbliga a diventare la sua tuttofare personale, facendole fare commissioni di ogni tipo a tutte le ore del giorno, fuori e a scuola. Al Buger Cat la ragazza se la dovrà vedere con due grossi problemi...

episodes.title: L'odioso e il piantagrane
episodes.synopsis: Il ragazzo del Buger Cat si rivela essere Seojun Han, una vecchia conoscenza di Suho. I due ragazzi, per qualche motivo, non sembrano andare d'accordo. Ora sono due le persone che hanno visto Jugyeong senza trucco.

episodes.title: Il pericolo è sempre dietro l'angolo
episodes.synopsis: La prima missione per diventare dea della Saebom è stata decisa: le ragazze dovranno sfidarsi in una gara di ballo. Sujin organizza un appuntamento al buio a Jugyeong, ma le cose non sono così belle come sembrano...

episodes.title: Pensavo che diventare bella avrebbe cambiato le cose
episodes.synopsis: Hyunwoo in realtà aveva secondi fini e non era il bel ragazzo che credeva Jugyeong. Ma ad architettare questo subdolo piano è stato qualcuno che si finge amico della protagonista. Nel mente il passato di Suho e Seojun sta venendo a galla...

episodes.title: This too shall pass away
episodes.synopsis: Suho si sta pian piano riprendendo dall'incidente e il giorno delle sue dimissioni Jugyeong scopre cos'è successo tra lui e Seojun. Nel mentre, la fine della prima missione si avvicina e la nostra protagonista non ha ancora girato il suo filmato, ma qualcuno andrà in suo soccorso.

episodes.title: E se in realtà mi piace?
episodes.synopsis: Chi avrà vinto la prima missione per diventare dea della Saebom? Nel mentre Seojun chiede a Jugyeong di aiutarlo con un lavoro part-time in una bancarella di una festa della loro città. Le cose sono tranquille finché non arriva Suho...

episodes.title: Smettila di illuderti
episodes.synopsis: Dopo la fiera, Jugyeong vede Sujin abbracciare Suho e così decide di evitare il ragazzo. Fortunatamente ha altro a cui pensare: la seconda missione è incominciata e questa volta c'è di mezzo la moda.

episodes.title: Il gioco della verità
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver affrontato Sujin per aver rubato l'outfit di Jugyeong, Sua invita Jugyeong e Chaerin a un pigiama party a casa sua, dove partecipano anche Suho e Seojun. Con la scusa del gioco della verità, Sua punta a capire cosa c'è tra Jugyeong e i due ragazzi.

episodes.title: Le dirò ciò che provo
episodes.synopsis: Dopo il gioco della verità sia Suho che Seojun si sono resi conto di essere innamorati di Jugyeong ed entrambi vogliono dichiararsi. Il primo a fare la mossa è Suho che la invita al cinema, ma il meteo non è dalla sua parte...

episodes.title: Dea in diretta streaming
episodes.synopsis: Il giorno è arrivato: Sujin Kang e Jugyeong Lim devono affrontarsi nella missione finale! Quest'ultima consiste in una diretta streaming, chi delle due avrà più mi piace diventerà la dea della Saebom.

episodes.title: Dea in diretta streaming 2
episodes.synopsis: L'ultima missione per diventare dea della Saebom si è trasformata in una vera e propria guerra! Jugyeong è stata tradita da una delle sue migliori amiche che si è alleata con la bulla che la tormentava nella vecchia scuola... Ma sarà davvero così?

episodes.title: Il nostro primo amore
episodes.synopsis: Finalmente le cose stanno andando per il verso giusto, Jugyeong è diventata dea della Saebom e tutti l'hanno accettato senza pregiudizi sul suo aspetto fisico! Ora la protagonista vuole dichiararsi a Suho, ma nubi di tempesta sono all'orizzonte...

info.title: Zenshu
info.synopsis: Dopo essersi diplomata al liceo, Natsuko Hirose inizia la sua carriera come animatrice. Il suo talento sboccia velocemente e viene subito notato permettendole di debuttare come regista in brevissimo tempo. Il suo primo anime diventa un enorme successo, che innesca un fenomeno sociale che la porta a guadagnarsi il riconoscimento di genio emergente. E ora sta lavorando ad un nuovo progetto che sarà una commedia romantica incentrata sul primo amore! Tuttavia Natsuko, non essendo mai stata innamorata fatica a capire questo concetto e non riesce a creare un storyboard adatto causando un arresto alla produzione del film.

info.title: Fafner
info.synopsis: La Terra è stata attaccata da misteriosi invasori e lo stesso Giappone sembra essere stato distrutto. Il protagonista di Soukyuu No Fafner è tuttavia all’oscuro di tutto e vive pacificamente su un’isola. Un giorno questa viene attaccata da un’invasore e scoprirà che in realtà l’intera isola è una base militare costruita appositamente per fronteggiarli. Il protagonista, messo davanti alla verità, diventerà il pilota di un robot. Il suo compito tuttavia è molto arduo, i nemici sono molto potenti e lo scontro comporta grandi perdite fra i civili. Resistere agli attacchi sembra molto dura, riusciranno a sopravvivere? A quale prezzo? E lui stesso che legami ha con il robot e quali cambiamenti comporterà nel suo corpo il diventarne il pilota?

episodes.synopsis: Introducing some of Tatsumiyajima's inhabitants, like the school going children: Kazuki, Maya, Hazama (sick in bed) and the rest of the gang. And Soshi (believed to have returned from a trip from Tokyo).

episodes.synopsis: Kazuki pilots the Fafner and defeats the enemy. But the children on the island, previously oblivious, must now  face the horrible reality of their situation.

episodes.title: Truth (Labyrinth)
episodes.synopsis: Various children on the island are selected for enrollment into the service, much to the dispair of many parents. Meanwhile, Kazuki discovers someone at the basement of the base. A search plane flys in the direction of the island's location. And an enemy appears at a bad time.

episodes.title: Pledge (Promise)

episodes.title: Sacrifice (Soaring Sky)
episodes.synopsis: Two Festums have appeared, and with Kazuki preoccupied with one of them, Shouko makes a decisive decision to act. Her actions saves the island and she keeps her promises to Kazuki and her mother. But the cost for everyone is too great.

episodes.title: Parent & Children (Family)
episodes.synopsis: Shouko's death is received with mix reactions. Kouyou's and Sakura's performance are tested against Kazuki's Mark Elf. An island showing similarities to the Tatsumiya island is discovered, a team is assembled to investigate.

episodes.title: Koyo (Strife)
episodes.synopsis: The team arrive on the island and various units set out to explore the apparently uninhabited island. Things go horribly wrong however.

episodes.title: Parting (Assimilation)
episodes.synopsis: Efforts to rescue Maya and Kyouhei from the island come at a great cost to Kouyou. And Kouyou's friends and family react to the great loss differently.

episodes.title: Crossing Paths (Disintegration)
episodes.synopsis: Hiroto Douma rebels and locks himself up in the school's broadcast room, apparently upset that his dreams of stardom may not be fulfilled.

episodes.title: Human Force (Old & New)
episodes.synopsis: Kazuki leaves the remote island with Yukie, taking the Fafner Mark Elf with him, arriving at a rundown city. Both Fumihiko and Kyouhei speculate about the sudden departure. After Kazuki and Yukie decide to make camp, they are then attacked by a Festum. Michio Hino and Canon Memphis, both piloting Fafners, appear and annihilate the Festum. However, the two then turn on Kazuki and disable his Fafner. Both Kazuki and Yukie is taken prisoner aboard the Neo UN fleet, having the Fafner Mark Elf in its possession. Soushi tells Maya that Kazuki wanted to escape from the island, though she disagrees with him.

episodes.title: Desperation (Absence)
episodes.synopsis: Mamoru Kodate, Kenji Kondo, and Sakura Kaname are among the candidates to pilot the Fafners. Meanwhile, Kazuki and Yukie are questioning the reason of their imprisonment. As a new Festum approaches, the new pilots are soon tested to defeat it. Mamoru devises a plan, ignoring Soushi's specified orders. The three collaboratively succeed in defeating the Festum, yet they are put in confinement for acting on their own judgment. Soushi learns from Fumihiko that Kazuki denies himself daily, bypassing any assimilation. Maya realizes that Soushi has feelings for Kazuki. Michio brings Kazuki to the deck of the ship, also encountering Canon, before arriving at the Moldova base.

episodes.title: Festum (Erosion)
episodes.synopsis: Mitsuhiro Bertrand says that Japan was destroyed thirty years ago when toxins were emitted from the core, which prevented citizens unable to produce offspring, marking the beginning of the attempted genocide of humanity by the Festums. When the Alvis base was founded, children were able to become immune to the Festums through gene manipulation. Hester deceptively announces of a new weapon capable of defeating Festums, having the Fafner Mark Elf displayed. Yoji Hino, who revealed he had left the island five years ago to create weapons for the Neo UN fleet, offers Kazuki to work for him as a staff member. The Grendel Type Festums invade the Moldova, prompting Kazuki to fight back.

episodes.title: Occupation (Awakening)
episodes.synopsis: Maya and Kyouhei go on a mission to rescue Kazuki at Moldova base. At the same time, the Neo UN fleet invades the Alvis base, trying to secure the island by taking control of the red female core, revealed to be a Coagula Type Festum, however it has left its container. Meanwhile, Yoji manages to persuade Mjolnir, the Master Type Festum which has assimilated Akane Makabe, to give the Fafner Mark Sein to Kazuki. Yukie, as well as Col. Dudley Barns, questions Fumihiko and Soushi concerning the whereabouts of the female core, but the latter two are unaware of its current location. While Kyouhei fends off the Festum in the laboratory, Yoji gives Maya the research data of the Fafner Mark Sein.

episodes.title: Scream (Memory)
episodes.synopsis: The Neo UN fleet occupies the Alvis base, however the female island core is still reported missing. Back at the Moldova base, Kazuki receives the Fafner Mark Sein from Mjolnir. Idun, another Master Type Festum, consumes Mjolnir, enraging Kazuki as he continues to fight. Both Kazuki and Idun sink into a lava pit generated by the Fafner Mark Sein. Kazuki confronts his internal conflicts about his past of when Soushi's left eye was first injured and of how the green crystals were first implanted in his body. Maya and Kyouhei witness Kazuki defeating Idun in the lava pit. Kazuki later tells Maya and Kyouhei that he is looking forward to protect the island after knowing what he is dealing with.

episodes.title: Welcome Home (Friends)
episodes.synopsis: The Neo UN fleet, taking control of the Alvis base, is faced with a new Festum that begins to assault the island. It is shown that Seri Tatekami was with the female island core, recognized as Tsubaki Minashiro, before she returns back to the base. Chizuru later finds Tsubaki and takes her to the lighthouse. Tsubaki leads Fumihiko and Soushi into a second command center. Mamoru, Kenji, and Sakura barely put up a fight against the Festum, as they are consequently defeated. Kazuki, in the Fafner Mark Sein, arrives in time, synchronizes himself with Soushi, and eradicates the Festum using a rifle gun and then a lance sword.

episodes.title: Device (Survival)
episodes.synopsis: Maya gives Fumihiko the research data, while Kyouhei informs that Yoki sacrificed himself to destroy the Festums in the laboratory. Tsubaki, now in the Alvis base, is revealed to be Soushi's younger sister. Michio is ordered to depart from the island, while Canon is requested to stay. Yukie docks a submarine near the island, and she activates the Fenrir System self-activation sequence. Michio becomes aware of this and warns the base of the threat. Kyouhei attempts to disarm the sequence, but Canon overrides the system. Michio takes care of the missiles launched by the fleet, while Kazuki, now released from probation, confronts Canon, managing to convince her to disarm the sequence.

episodes.title: Memory (Father)
episodes.synopsis: Adjusting to life on the island, Michio stays with Yumiko Tomi, while Canon resides with Yoko Hazama. All the children enjoy a moment at the beach. However, Mitsuhiro visits the island, soon discovering that the results of Maya's pilot aptitude test was falsified. He takes the issue to trial and tries to claim custody of Maya. Nevertheless, he is prevented from doing so by the testimonies of other pilots about the skewing of the test data. Tsubaki verifies all the claims and admits her involvement as well. Mitsuhiro leaves the island, warning the pilots of what is to come.

episodes.title: Sight (Maya)
episodes.synopsis: Maya, after showing progress during her training session, is assigned to be a sniper with the other pilots. Both Kazuki and Fumihiko are later invited by Michio and Yumiko to eat dinner with Maya and Chizuru. A notice is sent to inform of a bone festival that will take place in the evening to honor those to have been deceased. However, a group of Rare Type Festums soon approach the island, in which all pilots engage in battle against them. Sakura is caught by one of the Festums, and Kazuki manages to save her. Moreover, when another Festum attacks Maya from above, she shoots it at point blank, achieving victory.

episodes.title: Light (Lantern)
episodes.synopsis: The preparation of the bone festival is underway. Canon and Sakura make amends for what happened during the recent alien invasion. It is seen that Koyo, in his assimilated state, is released by Tsubaki after Chizuru had froze him in the capsule. The islanders enjoy the evening at the bone festival. The following day, the pilots realize that Koyo has left the base. They barricade him in a shrine to protect him. Soushi spars with Kazuki, while Kyouhei prepares to snipe Koyo. When Canon arrives, Koyo is reminded of Shoko from her clothing, as he is brought back to normal from his assimilated state.

episodes.title: Future (Sakura)
episodes.synopsis: After the pilots relax in the bathhouse, they are told that a training camp will be conducted during the weekend. Meanwhile, Fumihiko deduces that the recent strings of alien invasions may be a diversion to a separate agenda. As the pilots later defeat eight Festums spotted coming towards the island, sunflowers and cherry blossoms spontaneously begin to bloom. During the second phase of the training camp, the pilots are given assigned cleaning duties. They each then deal with their personal feelings and fears after the training camp.

episodes.title: Power (Protection)
episodes.synopsis: Sakura has revealed to have undergone assimilation, due to the recent alien invasion when she was caught by one of the Rare Type Festums. After the pilots defeat three Festums, they all react upon seeing Sakura hospitalized. Fumihiko confronts Tsubaki about the string of alien invasions and the island's change of weather and wildlife. The idea of integrating the Siegfried System within the Fafner Mark Sein is mentioned and discussed at the base. A new Festum appears and counters each attack of the pilots, leaving them unable to fight. Mamoru desperately attempts to immobilize the Festum, while Kazuki successfully runs the lance sword through the Festum. However, Mamoru is killed in the process.

episodes.title: Decoy (Pillage)
episodes.synopsis: At a Neo UN development base, Yukie is being tested to pilot the Fafner Mark Nicht, however Idun, who has taken human form, assimilates Yukie and destroys the development facility. Kazuki, Maya, and Canon are unable to bring Kenji back to the Alvis base, following Mamoru's death. Soushi, still in the Siegfried System, faces his past. Kazuki, assisted by Tsubaki, tries to save Soushi. However, Idun suddenly attacks the island and attempts to assimilate the entire base. Though Maya, Michio, and Canon intercept, they are easily defeated. Michio then activates the self-destruction sequence and attempts to ejects, but he is captured and dies in the blast. Also, Soushi disappears, along with the Siegfried System, infuriating Kazuki.

episodes.title: Mir (Conversation)
episodes.synopsis: Akane, still assimilated with Mjolnir, is rejected from merging with Meir, as she proceeds to the island. Kazuki and Maya visit Kenji with Kiyomi Kaname, in which Kenji challenges Kazuki to a match. Fumihiko decides to join the Neo UN fleet in an operation to take the the core of the Festums, much to the dismay of Kyouhei. Before the deployment of the remaining pilots, Mjolnir arrives on the island, explaining Fumihiko how Akane has accepted and blessed the Festums. Mjolnir then gives them data to reduce the assimilation process and to restore people who have been assimilated. Both Koyo and Mjolnir fend off the Festums attacking the island, as the pilots prepare for departure to the final battle.

episodes.title: The Sky (Azure)
episodes.synopsis: The four pilots all reunite and defeat Idun together. Meanwhile, Tsubaki struggles with her emotions at leaving to synchronize with the island core. Kazuki, with the help of Akane, manages to rescue Soushi, bearing the assimilation. As the Meir begins to make its way to the atmosphere, Maya snipes at it, preventing it from spreading all over the world. Tsubaki has become one with island, as she dissolves into thin air. Idun, barely alive in the Fafner Mark Nicht, hinders Kazuki and Soushi from leaving the battlefield, but Koyo is able to save the two. On their way to the island, Soushi vanishes because of his near assimilated state.

info.title: Mina
info.synopsis: L'umanità ha ormai da tempo contatti con varie civiltà aliene e ha scoperto che nessuna di loro pratica alcuno sport. Molti alieni, scoprendone l'esistenza, si appassionano agli sport terrestri, ma alcuni fanatici tra loro iniziano a interferire con le manifestazioni sportive. Pertanto viene istituita una squadra speciale, la Rabbit Force, composta da ragazze capaci di assumere l'aspetto di conigli e volta a impedire queste intromissioni.

episodes.title: First Jujitsu
episodes.synopsis: High school student, Miina Tsukada gets her dream job as an announcer at the all-famous, Luna-P news. After making a bad first impression, she is given a chance to redeem herself by interviewing a famous baseball player. But she finds he was attacked by an alien and soon becomes captured also. Ootsuki Miina saves her at the last minute, and leads the battle towards the baseball field, leaving Mina dumbfounded. Nanashi appears and tells Miina she can transform into a Getsumen To Heiki Miina. Miina reluctantly transforms but is still empowered to succeed in defeating the alien. Ootsuki and Tsukishiro(Mina) defeat and capture the alien together.

episodes.title: I Love Pro Wrestling
episodes.synopsis:
Mina is given the responsibility of hosting SpoLuna about the history of Japan's greatest professional wrestlers. After longs hours of research and typing, she presents it to Suirin, who rejects the script and tells her "this is not school work, it must be in your own words" Mina takes the new advice and restarts. On the day of her presentation, Escartin sabotages her by switching her script with a cook book. When Mina starts reading and finds out what happened, she freezes. But, remembering Suirin's words, Mina recites what she researched effortlessly. Towards the end an alien-who had taken the form of
Kato-attacks. Mina, overwhelmed by her emotions, takes a stand against the alien. But when the alien continues attack, Mina has no choice but to transform and fight the alien. Afterwards, Kato scolds her for leaving, but then she is told by a co-worker that she gained fan praise for standing up against the alien.

episodes.title: The Promised Dirty Pitch
episodes.synopsis: Mina is asked to interview her high school's baseball team, whom Kanchi plays for. When Mina tries to interview him, he shuns her. After talking with Nakoru, she tells Mina that Kanchi feels neglected by her ever since she got her job as an announcer. Mina is left feeling torn between her friends and her career. Afterwards, she and the news team do an overview of the high school's next game. But an L-alien(cheerleading alien) attacks and Mina must transform. After the battle, Mina decides to encourage and cheer for Kanchi, even though as an announcer, she is not allowed to bias. Kanchi wins the game and Mina gains fan praise for her cheering.

episodes.title: Mutsumune`s Big Break
episodes.synopsis: Escartin, Suirin, and Mina are representing SpoLuna at the SummerFest volleyball tournament. During the tournament, a Nipuru alien (trophy thief alien) disguises himself as one of the players and plays alongside with Escartin against Mina and Suirin. After losing a few rounds, Mina feels embarrassed and apologizes to Suirin. But Suirin reassures her that "victory is great, but its even better if you had fun earning it" Mina takes this advice and wins against Escartin but admits she was happier that she had fun rather than because she won. But afterwards, the alien reveals his true form and attacks. Mina transforms and fights alongside Ootsuki. But during battle Ootsuki reveals she enjoys battle and quotes Suirin's words about and enjoyed victory. Leaving Tsukishiro to ponder if Ootsuki is Suirin.

episodes.title: Red Card for Mina?
episodes.synopsis: Mina is confronted by child actress, Yuu Takanashi, who guest stars on SpoLuna. She threatens to reveal Mina's identity. Mina is then caught in the choice of erasing all of Yuu's memory. But then, after learning that Yuu's parents are never around and that the Ferris wheel is an important memory of them Mina realizes she shouldn't. Then, a Jagirian alien disrupts a soccer game, but Mina is captured. While Mina struggles to transform Yuu transforms into Tamamushi Miina and defeats the aliens herself. Afterwards, she discusses the trick she played on Mina to Nanashi on the Ferris wheel.

episodes.title: In the Open-Air Bath
episodes.synopsis: Mina and Kyru go over to the Hot Springs where a group of famous baseball players grew a strange stroke of violence whilst over there. The two are supposed to go there for publicity, but Mina finds herself growing reluctantly of her romantic feelings for Kyru. Meanwhile, Escartin sneaks to the Hot Spring to sabotage Mina once again. But her plans fail when she is captured by a group of personality-switching aliens that were responsible for the baseball players' violence. Escartin-now in a violent persona-attacks Mina, but Ootsuki comes in a rescues her. Once the alien emerges, Mina transforms. But the admits to Ootsuki that she wishes she wasn't a Miina because it gets in the ways of her responsibilities, and also admits that a crush on a co-worker(Kyru) gets in the way. Ootsuki admits also that a crush gets in the way of her responsibilities(hinting it may be Mina, or Kyru also). The two then battle the aliens together.

episodes.title: Suiren-senpai`s Affair
episodes.synopsis: A girl named Paparazzi takes a candid false photo of Surin having an affair. Resulting in Suirin not appearing at SpoLuna. Mina confronts Paparazzi, but ends up befriending her. While Mina is at work the next day, Paparazzi fulfills her fetish for antique military weaponry by trying to buy a tank. But it was really a trap for the aliens to kill her. When Mina leaves work to transform and battle, she and Paparazzi realise the reason why they wanted to kill Paparazzi: the picture also showed an alien terrorist hiding in the background. Which also reveals that Suirin was aware of the scam and tried to stop it; not having an affair. Then, Nanashi appears and shows that Paparazzi is a Rogue Miina, but gives her back her powers. Tsukishiro and Satsuki(Paparazzi) defeat the aliens.

episodes.title: Grumpy Nakoru
episodes.synopsis: Nakoru becomes more annoyed with Kanchi and has and scolds him. Nakoru talks it out with Mina, revealing that she and Kanchi aren't really sibling and that her mother left them. But and Abducto alien captures him and reveals his plan to capture famous baseball players and use their skills to create an ultimate baseball team and gain fame. Meanwhile, Tsukishiro takes Nakoru along with her to save Kanchi. During battle, Nakoru accidentally triggers her transformation, revealing that she is a Miina. She defeats the alien and Nanashi tells her that to avoid harassment from the aliens her mother moved away after giving her Miina powers to Nakoru. Tsukishiro is then left pondering the idea of her own mother as a Miina.

episodes.title: Deathmatch at One Thousand Kilometers
episodes.synopsis: All of the Miinas are captured by an alien. They must win a game of ping-pong against it or have their identities revealed. But the alien uses hypnotic powers on each Miina, which puts them in a sub-conscious state of mind to distract them from the game. But during the sub-conscious state of mind, the alien reveals that all of the Miinas, struggle with their own responsibilities and dreams. Tsukishiro realizes she's not the only one struggling. When Ootsuki plays, she counteracts the hypnotic spell by claiming she will never be defeated as long as she tried her best until the end. Tsukishiro recognizes the quote: a quote from Suirin years ago when she was Mina's age. Then, she realizes Ootsuki truly is Suirin. Ootsuki defeats the alien, but he reveals the Miina's identities anyway to every television in the world-or so he thinks-Nanashi deleted all video evidence of the Miinas. Unfortunately, the alien self-destructs the ship. Tamamushi, Satsuki and Minazuki were transported back to Earth by Nanashi, but Ootsuki and Tsukishiro are left in space. Ootsuki explains their situation, but Tsukishiro claims "she's not afraid as long as she's with Suirin" Ootsuki transports them back home.

episodes.title: I Came from Space
episodes.synopsis: The episode starts with Tsukishiro and Ootsuki fighting an alien at the beach. As usual, Ootsuki unintentionally causes mass damage to property. The next day, Mina is asked to interview a celebrity, Sumire Nishiha. The two enjoy themselves in an outdoor mall, until Sumire reveals her hatred for Ootsuki Miina. At SpoLuna, the cast discusses Ootsuki's damage and the public's complaints. Later on when the cast hosts a wrestling match, an alien attacks. Ootsuki chases after the alien but, yet again, causes more damage than needed. Then, the alien captures Kyru and threatens to kill Ootsuki if she tries to rescue him. Willing to make the sacrifice, Ootsuki proceeds as the alien electrocutes her. But rather than killing her, he returns her to her pedestrian form; revealing her identity. Just then Sumire appears as Shiratori Miina and convinces the public that Ootsuki Miina is an unfit heroine-and also offers the aliens their own personal sports arena on Planet Miina.

episodes.title: Final Announcement
episodes.synopsis: Suirin quits her job, as well as Kyru; feeling offended that she would keep a large secret from him. Leaving Mina in a great depression. While Sumire has gained utter control over seemingly everyone, Suirin comes over to her to have her powers evicted. Mina tries to continue her job at SpoLuna-which is being watched by everyone as well as Sumire-during the broadcast, Miina sends a message to Suirin that she should never give up, no matter what the costs are. She then transforms on set and goes to Sumire's jet to take Suirin. Meanwhile, Nanashi has a plot of his own: he has video evidence of Sumire plotting Ootsuki's downfall and the reason why. He manages to get the cast of SpoLuna to broadcast it, leaving the public to turn on Sumire. The other Miinas then transform and join Tsukishiro and Ootsuki to fight Sumire. Afterwards, the cast of SpoLuna celebrate at the sushi bar.

info.title: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses

Un giorno, viene improvvisamente invitato a formare un party da tre bellissime donne: Ciel, Anemone e Gore. Felicissimo di partire per un'avventura, Toto è pieno d'entusiasmo... ma non sa che queste donne sono intenzionate a ucciderlo!

info.title: I Saved Myself with a Potion!: Life in Another World
info.synopsis: Kaede, una normale liceale, si risveglia improvvisamente in un vicolo sconosciuto—solo per rendersi conto di essere stata trasportata in un misterioso mondo abitato da uomini-bestia, elfi e draghi. Tra i suoi effetti personali scopre un libro strano, che prima non c’era. Con sua grande sorpresa, esso le permette di creare pozioni semplicemente pronunciando la parola “crea.” Affidandosi a queste pozioni per sopravvivere, Kaede affronta le sfide di quel mondo fantastico, aggrappandosi alla speranza di poter un giorno tornare in Giappone. Il suo viaggio di lotta e scoperta in questa dimensione sconosciuta è appena iniziato...

episodes.title: Potion Creation
episodes.synopsis: Kaede, an ordinary high school girl, wakes up in a strange world and finds a book she doesn't recognize. The book says that she can make a potion by simply gathering the ingredients and chanting "create."

episodes.title: Mysterious Bag
episodes.synopsis: Kaede has successfully secured food and lodging by selling the potions she created. While searching for a bag large enough to hold more potions, she comes across an especially expensive bag...!?

episodes.title: First Outing
episodes.synopsis: Wanting to create a large amount of potions without being seen, Kaede comes up with the idea of ​​creating them in a river outside the city. When Kaede makes a request at the guild, a man and woman named Sherry and Ranji appear before her...!?

episodes.title: Kaede's Shop
episodes.synopsis: With the encouragement of the pharmacist, Kaede decides to open a stall and sell potions. Kaede is about to start the stall right away, but then Sherry shows up...

episodes.title: Rude Elf
episodes.synopsis: A group of dragon hunters suddenly appears. They say they want to meet the creator of Kaede's potion. One of the dragon hunters, a slightly unsociable elf, has a special constitution...

episodes.title: Thunder Crystal
episodes.synopsis:
Kaede has some time before her appointment with Asuru, and she becomes interested in the new "crystal stone" that has been added to her recipe book.

She stops by a magic stone shop to buy some ingredients, and meets a dragon woman, but...

episodes.title: Outskirts Residence
episodes.synopsis: Kaede's achievements in slaying a dragon have been recognized, and she comes to the royal capital with Asuru and the others. Ray, the leader of the Dragon Hunters, takes a liking to her, and introduces her to an acquaintance who is selling a house.

episodes.title: A Small Housemate
episodes.synopsis: Kaede has finally purchased her dream home, but it turns out that a fairy named Nina has also taken up residence in the house. Kaede has become friends with Nina and even set up a stall in the royal capital, and life in her new place seems to be off to a good start...

episodes.title: A Fateful Encounter
episodes.synopsis: Kaede has been attacked by robbers who are after the money she earns from her street stall. As a countermeasure, Rei encourages her to buy a slave for her own safety. Kaede doesn't approve of slavery and is reluctant to do so, so she decides to hire a bodyguard for the time being, but...

episodes.title: Three Brothers
episodes.synopsis: After meeting a werewolf slave named Karudeno, Kaede heads into the forest to gather ingredients for a High Potion. With Karudeno's help as her escort, Kaede and her friends make good progress deeper into the forest, but then they come across a trio being chased by a wild boar.

episodes.title: The Fairy Spring

info.title: Le Bizzarre Avventure di JoJo: Stardust Crusaders (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il protagonista Jonathan Joestar, nell'Inghilterra alla fine del diciannovesimo secolo, è il figlio del ricco lord George Joestar I. Questi adotta Dio Brando, coetaneo di Jonathan e figlio di Dario, uno sbandato che lo stava derubando a seguito di un incidente e che lui crede gli abbia salvato la vita. Dio, la cui vera indole è ambiziosa e perversa, vuole impadronirsi del casato dei Joestar, prima privando Jonathan di ogni amicizia e affetto, e poi cercando di uccidere il genitore adottivo con lo stesso veleno con cui aveva ucciso il padre. Scoperto e messo alle corde, usa su di sé la Maschera di Pietra, un portentoso artefatto di origine azteca in grado di trasformare l'uomo in un vampiro. Per affrontarlo, Jonathan apprenderà la tecnica delle onde concentriche dal misterioso avventuriero Will A. Zeppeli, grazie alla quale potrà scontrarsi contro zombie e cavalieri medievali evocati da Dio Brando, tra i quali Jack lo Squartatore, Bruford e Tarkus, e Doobie lo spettro, fino allo scontro finale con il nemico. Alla fine Jonathan muore tragicamente, portando con sé (nell'esplosione finale della nave che avrebbe dovuto condurlo in viaggio di nozze) la testa, ancora viva e pericolosa, di un Dio Brando ormai disperato che cerca di appropriarsi del corpo del suo rivale. Entrambi periscono nell'esplosione e nell'affondamento della nave. O almeno così sembra...

episodes.title: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
episodes.synopsis: In 1987, in Japan, a boy named Jotaro Kujo has willingly turned himself into jail, refusing to leave. Jotaro's mother, Holy, requests help from her father, Joseph Joestar, who travels to Japan alongside an acquaintance, Muhammad Avdol.

episodes.title: Who Will Be the Judge!?
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro heads to school and encounters a mysterious transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin.

episodes.title: The Curse of Dio
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro is able to defeat Kakyoin. He takes the wounded Kakyoin back to his house, hoping to get some information about DIO.

episodes.title: Tower of Gray
episodes.synopsis: If they do not defeat DIO within 50 days, Holy could die - Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think DIO is hiding. While on the plane, they run into another one of DIO's assassins.

episodes.title: Silver Chariot
episodes.synopsis: DIO's next assassin, Polnareff, attacks Jotaro and crew, Avdol faces him with his Magician's Red.

episodes.title: Dark Blue Moon
episodes.synopsis: With a new person in their party, they head to Singapore with the boat the Speedwagon Foundation provided them, during their journey Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.

episodes.title: Strength
episodes.synopsis: A giant ship shows itself . On board, they realize they can't seem to find a crew, but an orangutan.

episodes.title: The Devil
episodes.synopsis: Arrived at Singapore, Jotaro's group stay at hotel individualy. A new Stand owner who is afraid as "Devo the Cursed" is awaited Polnareff in his room. Devo's Stand increases its power as its user's hatred toward opponent increases. Polnareff gets into desperate situation as he starts fighting front. Does Polnareff have a chance to win the battle from Devo who keeps attacking him with cruel and brutal way?

episodes.title: Yellow Temperance
episodes.synopsis: Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.

episodes.title: The Emperor and The Hanged Man, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: The group travels to India. In a restaurant Polnareff is attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.

episodes.title: The Emperor and The Hanged Man, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: In an effort to save Polnareff, Avdol is injured by the enemy. Then J. Geil's Stand, Hanged Man attacks.

episodes.title: The Empress
episodes.synopsis: The group heads toward Varanasi. On the way, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.

episodes.title: Wheel of Fortune
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others head toward Pakistan in a car. Polnareff is driving the car on a very dangerous mountain road, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.

episodes.title: Justice, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan. However, they decide to find an inn at a nearby village because of the dense fog they suddenly hit. The village they get to is rather quiet and all of the inhabitants seem rather odd.

episodes.title: Justice, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Polnareff finally realizes that Enya is another assassin from DIO. He tries to warn the others, but Enya's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he is pursued. The whole village had already been under Enya's control.

episodes.title: The Lovers, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: After surviving Enya's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Steely Dan. Following DIO's orders, Steely Dan ruthlessly kills Enya in front of them. Jotaro and the others can't help but feel conflicted about that happening, and end up in a battle with Steely Dan.

episodes.title: The Lovers, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Steely Dan's Stand, Lovers, has entered Joseph's brain. Dan puts himself at an advantage, with having Joseph's life on the line, and tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey. Meanwhile, Kakyoin and Polnareff also enter Joseph's brain with their Stands and find the Stand that is using brain cells as food.

episodes.title: The Sun
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others continue their journey through the desert, trying to get to Cairo. They travel with camels and can't shake the feeling that someone is following them, but no one is in sight. Traveling in the killer heat, they realize that it's still bright out at 8pm and the sun is actually rising rather than setting.

episodes.title: Death 13, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Kakyoin is dreaming and dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream, he witnesses Death cut down a dog. Kakyoin wakes up screaming, but can't remember what his bad dream was about.

episodes.title: Death 13, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is suspicious, but that backfires, and his friends start to doubt his sanity. Kakyoin then tries to convince them that he's not crazy, and shows them his arm that has "Baby Stand" carved into it... but that just makes them believe he really is crazy. Kakyoin then tries to use his Stand to attack, but is knocked out by Polnareff. Eventually, Jotaro and the others wake up in the nightmare and the truth finally comes out.

episodes.title: Judgment, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: While on an island on the edge of the Red Sea where Muhammad Avdol's father is said to live, Polnareff uncovers a magic lamp and its genie Cameo offers him three wishes, although all is not as it seems.

episodes.title: Judgment, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Polnareff must find out a way to escape the attacks of Cameo and his Stand Judgement who has apparently turned his sister Sherry and Avdol into zombies.

episodes.title: The High Priestess, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of travel. Through the Red Sea, they try to head toward Egypt where DIO awaits. Using the sonar to detect any threats on the outside, the submarine quietly dives in. They however realize that if they're attacked underwater, there is nowhere to escape, so they are on their guard. Finally, when they are about to surface, a coffee mug that was in the cabin transforms and cuts off Joseph's artificial hand.

episodes.title: The High Priestess, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: The group must find a way off of the submarine and away from the attacks of High Priestess.

info.title: Overgeared (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nel mondo reale, Youngwoo Shin è un ragazzo sommerso dai debiti e considerato da tutti un fallito. La sua unica fuga è Satisfy, il gioco di realtà virtuale più famoso del pianeta, dove gioca con l'avatar Grid. Anche lì, però, la sfortuna lo perseguita, lasciandolo bloccato ai livelli più bassi. Tutto cambia quando scopre per caso un libro leggendario e sblocca una classe unica e mai vista: Il Discendente di Pagma. Anche se il suo livello viene resettato a 1, Grid ottiene un potere straordinario: la capacità di forgiare e soprattutto equipaggiare qualsiasi arma o armatura del gioco, ignorando ogni restrizione di livello o classe. Mentre gli altri giocatori puntano su magie e abilità di combattimento, Grid deciderà di scalare le classifiche mondiali e diventare il giocatore più forte di tutti sfruttando un'unica, devastante strategia: il potere assoluto degli oggetti.
